meta.name: os-lab-scorer
meta.description: Locked KEEP/DISCARD check for one change to a skill. Runs evaluate.py headlessly, compares accuracy and F1 against the baseline in evals/results.tsv, applies the holdout overfitting gate, and returns exit 0 (KEEP) or 1 (DISCARD, auto-reverted). Also runs a single-pass RED-GREEN-REFACTOR fix: baseline the failure, state a hypothesis, patch SKILL.md, require KEEP. Use when the user says "evaluate this skill", "score this change", "KEEP or DISCARD", "improve skill routing", "skill is not triggering", "fix skill description", or when os-lab-loop proposes a change that needs validation. DO NOT USE for the multi-iteration loop (os-lab-loop), building the lab repo (os-lab-setup), planning (os-lab-planner), reviewing a lab diff (os-lab-backport), run logs and charts (os-lab-log), or memory promotion (os-lab-memory). NOT for scaffolding new skills: use create-skill (agent-scaffolders).
